seoDescription: Find answers to the most frequently asked questions about Max-Morrys's courses, coaching and services.
heroSubtitle: Quickly find answers to your most common questions.
ctaText: Feel free to reach out to me directly.
crossText: I reply personally to every message. Don't hesitate to get in touch.

index.lede: If a question keeps coming back, it ends up here. That's how this page gets written.
index.contactBody: Write to me. I'm the one who reads, and the one who answers — count two working days.
index.truthTitle: A question deserves a full answer
index.truthBody: « How many members are in the Club? » has its answer here, and it starts with: « I won't tell you, because the number would be false. » A FAQ that dodges its awkward questions is useless.
index.empty: No question matches. Drop a filter, or clear the search.

question.notFoundBody: This address doesn't match any question. It may have been reworded — the index carries them all.
question.neighboursEmpty: It's the only question in this category, for now.
question.shareFailed: The copy didn't go through. The address is in your browser bar.
question.truthBody: The index on its own gave no question a shareable URL or a search position of its own. One page per question, with its trail and its structured data, closes that gap.
